name: Elephant Money Reserve TRUNK mint/redeem spot-price valuation
summary: The Elephant Money Reserve priced TRUNK mint and redeem from live PancakeSwap ELEPHANT/WBNB and WBNB/BUSD reserves in the same transaction. With flash-loaned BNB and BUSD the attacker pumped ELEPHANT, minted TRUNK, dumped ELEPHANT, then redeemed the TRUNK so the Reserve paid out a multiple of the ELEPHANT pool from its treasury.
notes: Reset: after deploying the Reserve the team granted it the TRUNK mint role and whitelisted it on the ELEPHANT and BUSD treasuries; redeem needs all three, and the BUSD treasury whitelisting came last.
The drained ELEPHANT has no usable price (the attack set it), so the loss is valued at the BNB the attacker realised; ELEPHANT left unsold in the attack contract is not counted.
No other transaction minted and redeemed in one go before redeem stopped, so the campaign is empty.
